_provenance_note: Every curve here was extracted by full-text read of the named primary source on 2026-07-14 (research session 2, agents' reads logged in data/literature_delta.md). Cumulative F(>=N) values are derived arithmetic from the sources' per-incident tables; populations are mid-period national estimates from the named statistical agency series. NEVER add a curve without source, pop_millions, and a full-text read (F159 discipline).
figure_note:
Scopes differ by source and are stated per curve:
Singapore = building-envelope fires (this study); China = all fires;
Australia = preventable residential fires; New Zealand = unintentional
domestic fires. F divided by mid-period national population.

curves.label: China 1998-2002, all fires (Wang et al. 2005)
curves.source: Wang F, Lu S, Li C. Fire Safety Science 8:353-362 (2005), DOI 10.3801/iafss.fss.8-353. Cumulative F(>=N) derived from per-year incident counts in Table 4 (p.359); N4/N5 and N6-N9 are merged bins in the source, so F is resolvable only at the N values listed (markers, not steps). Population 1,266 million (year 2000) as stated in the paper's Table 1. Full PDF read 2026-07-14; two internal text inconsistencies in the source (its stated N1 total 5625 vs table-summed 6963; its stated '34 incidents >10 fatalities' vs table-derived 35 at >=10) are documented in data/literature_delta.md and neither affects the table-derived values used here.

curves.label: Australia FY2004-2017, preventable residential fires (Coates et al. 2019)
curves.scope: preventable residential fires only; final 2-3 years under-reported 7-23% per source
curves.source: Coates L et al. Preventable Residential Fire Fatalities in Australia July 2003 to June 2017. Bushfire and Natural Hazards CRC Report 506.2019, Table 8 p.40 (753 x N1, 41 x N2, 7 x N3, 7 x N4, 2 x N>4). Cumulative F(>=N) = derived; the '>4' bin enters as F(>=5) = 2/14 with the events' exact sizes unknown, so the curve terminates at N=5 open-ended. Population: ABS National, state and territory population, table 310101 (ERP 30 Jun 2010 = 22,031,800; 30 Jun 2011 = 22,340,000; mid-window mean 22,185,900). Full PDF read 2026-07-14.

curves.label: New Zealand 2007-2014, unintentional domestic fires (Lilley & McNoe 2018)
curves.source: Lilley R, McNoe B. Unintentional Domestic Fire-Related Fatal Injury in New Zealand: 2007-2014. Fire and Emergency New Zealand Research Report 167 (2018), ISBN 978-1-92-728727-9 (98 x N1, 6 x N2, 2 x N3, 1 x N4 = 107 incidents; source's stated 118 total deaths vs implied 120 is a 2-death internal inconsistency in the source, noted not resolved). Cumulative F(>=N) = derived. Population: Stats NZ National population estimates at 30 June 2018, Table 1 (ERP 30 Jun 2010 = 4,350,700; 30 Jun 2011 = 4,384,000; mid-window mean 4,367,350). Full PDF read (Wayback snapshot) 2026-07-14.
